lockNote: Original GW7 pre-deadline forecast and checkpoint are unavailable. This fixed audit baseline was reconstructed after the deadline from data through GW6 and must not be described as the published GW7 prediction.

reconstruction.noLookahead: Projection features use only event live feeds for GW1-GW6 and finished fixtures before GW7. GW7 actuals, scores, team form, and live player news are used only in the separate scoring report.
limitations: The original GW7 deadline model version and exact player/news state cannot be recovered.
Availability and injury news are neutral assumptions because a GW7 pre-deadline news snapshot is missing.
The player universe, team, position, and price baseline come from the frozen GW6 export.
Model code version 1.4.0 is applied retrospectively and is not the model version published for GW7.
The archive is an audit reconstruction and is not directly comparable to published pre-deadline reports.

training.method: Retrospective walk-forward reconstruction using official FPL live player statistics and completed fixtures through GW6.
training.validation: Not a recovered deadline forecast; neutral availability and no historical news/market snapshot.
training.source: Official FPL bootstrap, fixtures, and event live feeds.
